instruction: Use the ansible provisioner with extra vars in Packer
output: echo 'provisioner "ansible" { playbook_file = "playbook.yml" extra_arguments = ["--extra-vars", "@vars/packer.json"] ansible_env_vars = ["ANSIBLE_HOST_KEY_CHECKING=False"] }' > ansible-extra.pkr.hcl

instruction: Use the ansible provisioner in local mode
output: echo 'provisioner "ansible-local" { playbook_file = "/tmp/playbook.yml" }' > ansible-local.pkr.hcl

instruction: Use the file provisioner to download from guest
output: echo 'provisioner "file" { source = "/var/log/install.log" destination = "logs/" direction = "download" }' > file-download.pkr.hcl

instruction: Upload entire directory via file provisioner
output: echo 'provisioner "file" { source = "dist/" destination = "/opt/app/" }' > file-upload.pkr.hcl

instruction: Use the Windows restart with custom timeout
output: echo 'provisioner "windows-restart" { restart_timeout = "15m" }' > win-restart.pkr.hcl

instruction: Use the puppet-server provisioner
output: echo 'provisioner "puppet-server" { puppet_server = "puppet.example.com" puppet_node = var.node_name }' > puppet-server.pkr.hcl

instruction: Use the Chef Solo provisioner with JSON attributes
output: echo 'provisioner "chef-solo" { cookbook_paths = ["cookbooks"] json = { "nginx" => { "port" => 8080 } } }' > chef-json.pkr.hcl

instruction: Use the converge provisioner with params
output: echo 'provisioner "converge" { module = "app" params = { "version" => var.app_version } }' > converge-params.pkr.hcl

instruction: Install multiple packages via shell provisioner
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo apt install -y nginx postgresql-client redis-tools"] }' > install-multi.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a user during Packer build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo useradd -m -s /bin/bash deploy", "sudo mkdir -p ~deploy/.ssh", "sudo chmod 700 ~deploy/.ssh"] }' > user-create.pkr.hcl

instruction: Harden SSH config in a Packer provisioner
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo sed -i 's/PermitRootLogin yes/PermitRootLogin no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config", "sudo sed -i 's/#PasswordAuthentication yes/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config"] }' > harden-ssh.pkr.hcl

instruction: Install and configure fail2ban in Packer
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo apt install -y fail2ban", "sudo cp /etc/fail2ban/jail.conf /etc/fail2ban/jail.local", "sudo systemctl enable fail2ban"] }' > fail2ban.pkr.hcl

instruction: Set up a simple firewall with ufw in Packer
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo ufw default deny incoming", "sudo ufw default allow outgoing", "sudo ufw allow ssh", "sudo ufw --force enable"] }' > ufw.pkr.hcl

instruction: Install Docker in the Packer build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sudo sh", "sudo usermod -aG docker ubuntu"] }' > docker-install.pkr.hcl

instruction: Install Node.js and npm in a Packer build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | sudo -E bash -", "sudo apt install -y nodejs"] }' > nodejs.pkr.hcl

instruction: Install Python 3 and pip in Packer
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo apt install -y python3 python3-pip python3-venv"] }' > python.pkr.hcl

instruction: Create a swap file during Packer build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo fallocate -l 2G /swapfile", "sudo chmod 600 /swapfile", "sudo mkswap /swapfile", "sudo swapon /swapfile"] }' > swap.pkr.hcl

instruction: Configure sysctl parameters in the image
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["echo 'net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1' | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.conf", "sudo sysctl -p"] }' > sysctl.pkr.hcl

instruction: Set timezone during Packer build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo timedatectl set-timezone UTC"] }' > timezone.pkr.hcl

instruction: Update CA certificates in the image
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo apt install -y ca-certificates", "sudo update-ca-certificates"] }' > ca-certs.pkr.hcl

instruction: Install CloudWatch agent via Packer
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["curl -O https://s3.amazonaws.com/amazoncloudwatch-agent/debian/amd64/latest/amazon-cloudwatch-agent.deb", "sudo dpkg -i amazon-cloudwatch-agent.deb"] }' > cw-agent.pkr.hcl

instruction: Install the SSM agent in a Packer build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["curl -O https://s3.amazonaws.com/ec2-downloads-windows/SSMAgent/latest/debian_amd64/amazon-ssm-agent.deb", "sudo dpkg -i amazon-ssm-agent.deb"] }' > ssm-agent.pkr.hcl

instruction: Install New Relic agent in a Packer build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["curl -Ls https://download.newrelic.com/debian/newrelic.list | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/newrelic.list", "sudo apt update", "sudo apt install -y newrelic-infra"] }' > newrelic.pkr.hcl

instruction: Install Datadog agent in a Packer build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["DD_API_KEY=${var.dd_api_key} bash -c \"$(curl -L https://s3.amazonaws.com/dd-agent/scripts/install_script.sh)\""] }' > datadog.pkr.hcl

instruction: Clean up package cache at the end of a Packer build
output: echo 'provisioner "shell" { inline = ["sudo apt clean", "sudo apt autoremove -y", "sudo rm -rf /var/log/*.log", "sudo rm -rf /tmp/*"] }' > cleanup.pkr.hcl
